component.name: Playlist
component.summary: Liberate your music, own your data, support artists

description.p: Playlist is a desktop music manager that liberates your music from streaming platforms. Download tracks from almost anywhere, discover missing albums and tracks for artists in your library, sync your collection across devices, and play everything locally — no subscriptions, no lock-in. Support artists directly by buying their music, not renting it.

ul.li: Download tracks from YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, and hundreds more sources
Search for missing tracks in albums and discover albums for artists in your library
Automatic metadata enrichment from MusicBrainz and Last.fm
Full local playback with queue, shuffle, and repeat
Playlist management, album views, and library organization
System tray integration for background playback

description.p: Bug fixes and platform compatibility improvements.
